about.title: Newark Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a fatal collision happens on a road you drive every day — Cedar Boulevard, Thornton Avenue, Cherry Street, or Newark Boulevard — the grief is compounded by confusion about what comes next. Alameda County recorded 2 traffic deaths in the most recent final crash year alongside 105 injury collisions in Newark, numbers that represent real families now facing funeral costs, lost income, and an absence no settlement can fill. California law allows a spouse, domestic partner, or children to bring a wrongful death claim, with certain dependents or heirs eligible if none of those survive. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we connect grieving families with an independent attorney who can evaluate the crash, identify who may recover, and pursue funeral expenses, lost financial support, and loss of companionship on a contingency basis. There's no cost to start a conversation, and no pressure to act before you're ready.

items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse, domestic partner, or children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible only if none of those survive. An attorney in our network can help sort out who qualifies before deadlines pass.

items.title: A Firm Deadline That Doesn't Wait
items.desc: Wrongful death claims generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity was involved, such as a city road defect on Newark Boulevard. Acting sooner preserves evidence and options.

items.title: No Fee Unless There's a Recovery

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim in Newark?
items.answer: California generally gives you two years from the date of death to file a civil wrongful death claim. If a government agency, like the City of Newark or Caltrans, may share fault, that deadline is much shorter, so it's wise to speak with an attorney promptly. Missing these windows can permanently bar recovery.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim after a crash on Cedar Boulevard or Thornton Avenue?
items.answer: California law prioritizes a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children to bring the claim. If none of those survive, certain other dependents or heirs may have standing. An independent attorney can review your family's situation and confirm who qualifies.

items.question: What can a wrongful death claim actually recover?
items.answer: Recoverable losses typically include funeral and burial costs, the financial support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance the family has suffered. This is separate from any criminal charges the at-fault driver might face. No two families' losses are identical, so an attorney would evaluate your specific circumstances.
